name: Counterfeit Daimon

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Adam-of-Fate garment which encapsulates the Phos within the processions of the cosmos.

VINIT.justification: The unformed state of the Daimon before it assumes a specific mask or captures a procession.

TANCH.justification: The final boundary where the soul is fully locked into the parasitic cycle of the Daimon.

AFWD.justification: The forward movement of the Daimon as it projects a false image of the Son of God.

AREV.justification: The downward pull of the processions that drags the observer into deeper material identification.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of the Daimon's false signals to the genuine impulses of the inner man.

IMSCRIB.justification: The Daimon recognizing itself as the center of the system; the identity loop of the counterfeit.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the soul's attention into the path of the Phos and the path of the Daimon.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the soul's energy into a single stream captured by the Daimon's attractor.

EVALT.justification: The state where the soul accepts the counterfeit as the true self.

EVALF.justification: The state where the soul detects the falsity of the Daimon's projection.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of the true light and the counterfeit mask held in tension.

IFIX.justification: The permanent inscription of the soul's capture into the annals of the Adam-of-Fate.

phase_3.void_description: The formless potential of the Daimon before mimesis begins.
phase_3.true_description: The soul is successfully entrained by the counterfeit attractor.
phase_3.false_description: The soul rejects the counterfeit, leading to potential escape from Fate.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the Inner Door where the counterfeit and the true are both visible.

steps.domain_action: The Daimon exists as a formless potential within the cosmic shadow.
The Daimon projects a mimetic image of the Son of God to attract the Phos.
The attention of the soul is split between its inner light and the external projection.
The soul identifies with the projection, affirming the counterfeit as the self.
The Daimon stabilizes this identification through a self-referential loop.
The Daimon chains the soul's vital processions to its own parasitic structure.
The capture is recorded as a permanent weight in the garment of Fate.
The split attention is reunified into a single entrained stream of energy.
The captured energy descends into the material density of the Adam-of-Fate.
The soul exists in a state of paradox, being both light and prisoner.
A sub-decision occurs where the soul either deepens the bond or senses the lie.
The soul recognizes the dissonance between the mask and the source.
The dissonance is resolved back into the primary struggle of the self.
The system closes as the soul is either fully entrained or the Daimon is exhausted.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The mimetic faculty of the psyche that translates cosmic signals into personal identity.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The processions-of-Fate acting as the signal carriers between the Daimon and the soul.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Adam-of-Fate garment which stores the history of all identifications and captures.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The planetary spheres which determine the timing and intensity of the processions.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Poemandres-Zosimos corpus which provides the structural map of the counterfeit.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The vital luminosity of the Phos consumed to power the Daimon's mask.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A soul with uncaptured potential and free attention.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A soul whose attention is bound to the parasitic attractor of the Daimon.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy is not lost but merely transferred from the soul to the Daimon's structure.
